messages:
incident-bot: CRITICAL: dedicated pool 'dedicated-us-central' at capacity. 5m GPU avg 97%. Request queue length rising, increased 429s on /v1/generate and p95 lat ~370ms. Paging on-call.

Ravi: picking up. Where are errors concentrated? Any correlation with bulk jobs or canaries?

Sasha: Checking traces and recent traffic, looks like a large burst from a batch ingestion job and also higher interactive usage from a couple of enterprise tenants. No recent deploys to runtime.

Priya - CS: FYI support has incoming tickets from nova-pay and monohealth complaining about timeouts and some 429s. They've asked for an ETA quickly.

Jun: Quick config check: pool is configured with burst_capacity=false. I see an IaC change in infra PR #3561 flipped the default for several pools during the infra cleanup. Seems to have removed emergency burst.

Ravi: OK. Two-pronged plan: (1) enable burst_capacity for the pool to allow immediate headroom, (2) apply targeted traffic shaping so non-critical/experimental routes are penalized, (3) temporarily raise enterprise quotas for affected tenants to avoid throttling. Anyone object?

Sasha: No objections. I'll do the route shaping. Jun, can you toggle burst? Please use runbook command and annotate.

Jun: Running the toggle per runbook:
```
# enable short burst window on pool (idempotent)
infractl pool set --pool dedicated-us-central --burst on --burst-window 20m --reason "emergency surge - enabling burst"
# also nudge autoscaler to provision two extra nodes while burst warms
infractl pool scale --pool dedicated-us-central --delta 2 --reason "manual bump during surge"
```
Executing...

deploy-bot: Automation: scaling request accepted for dedicated-us-central. New nodes provisioning: node-812, node-813. Estimated ready 100-140s.

Sasha: Applying traffic shaping to deprioritize experimental and low-priority routes:
```
rdwctl traffic-shape add --pool dedicated-us-central --match "/v1/exp*" --priority low --limit 25r/s --reason "shed experimental traffic during surge"
rdwctl traffic-shape add --pool dedicated-us-central --match "/v1/rerank*" --priority low --limit 20r/s --reason "shed rerank during surge"
```
Commands applied. This should reduce background noise.

Ravi: Priya - CS, can you inform nova-pay and monohealth that we're enabling emergency burst and increasing quotas for them? Give a short ETA.

Priya - CS: Notified both. Message: "We're aware of elevated latency and 429s. We've enabled short-term burst capacity and temporarily increased your quota. Expect stabilization within ~6 minutes; we'll follow up when metrics are green." They want to know what changed; will tell them config drift due to recent infra cleanup removed burst flag.

Jun: Applying customer quota overrides now to avoid them hitting global rate limits while nodes warm:
```
rdwctl quotas override --tenant nova-pay --burst 60000 --window 60s --reason "emergency quota during surge"
rdwctl quotas override --tenant monohealth --burst 50000 --window 60s --reason "emergency quota during surge"
```
Overrides applied.

deploy-bot: node-812 ready, node-813 ready. Autoscaler reports pool capacity healthy. LB rebalanced.

Sasha: Early metrics: queue length dropping, GPU util falling to ~68%, p95 latency back down to ~160ms. 429 rate decreased substantially.

Ravi: Good. Keep burst on for the next 40 minutes to be safe, then revert if traffic subsides. Jun, please annotate the infra PR and revert the default change. Also open a ticket to add a CI check preventing burst flag removal on prod pools.

Jun: On it. I'll create a follow-up: ENG-PLAT-4622 with links to the PR and runbook snippets. Also adding a checklist entry to require reviewer signoff for pool config changes.

Priya - CS: Customers acknowledged the update and appreciate the quick response. Asked for a post-incident note.

Ravi: Postmortem notes to capture: root cause = unintended IaC default flip disabling burst on dedicated pools + unexpected traffic surge from batch job. Live mitigations = enabled burst, manual scale +2, applied traffic shaping, temporary tenant quota overrides, customer communication. Action items: CI guard for pool configs, alert threshold tuning (scale alert to trigger at sustained 80% util for 3m), runbook update with one-line commands and stakeholder contact list.

Sasha: I'm going to leave the traffic-shape in place for 15 minutes more and then gradually relax if metrics remain stable.

deploy-bot: Automation: incident recorded INC-2090012345. Burst flag set to on for 20m; timer started.

Ravi: Handoff: I'm oncall for another 25 minutes, then Sasha will take over monitoring. If anything regresses, page immediately. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

(End of thread)
